SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Review heatmap
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: A year or a month of reviews done and cards due, below the decks

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Time per deck
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: The time answered today on each deck row

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Lofi button
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Lofi music while you study: tap the headphones in the deck list or the reviewer, long-press for tracks, volume and sources

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: RWKV forecast
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Under 'Studied today': review cards due, added by the daily minimum, near the line and safe now, and how many more become due in 1 h, 3 h and by tomorrow. Not shown above 3000 review cards (too slow)

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: RWKV forecast graph
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Below the heatmap: a dot per review card at its recall now, coloured like the forecast's counts. Not shown above 3000 review cards either

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: 'Rebuilding RWKV' message
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Shown when the RWKV state is rebuilt (first start, after an update), and a notification when it is ready

ListPreference.android:title: RWKV model
ListPreference.android:summary: %s. Big: the desktop fork's model. Small: JSchoreels' 331k-parameter model, about 0.7%% less accurate (log loss, 1,000 held-out users), with about a quarter of the memory and rebuilds about 3x faster: a 4M-review, 100k-card collection rebuilds in under 1 GB, where the big model needs 2.6 GB. A change rebuilds the RWKV state from the review history

ListPreference.android:title: RWKV state precision
ListPreference.android:summary: %s. How each card's RWKV memory is kept, as in the desktop fork: int8 uses about a third of f32's memory with the same accuracy; int4 cards / int8 notes a quarter less than int8, slightly less accurate. A change rebuilds the RWKV state from the review history

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Fade answer buttons
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: After Show answer, the answer buttons fade in (200 ms). Off: they appear at once

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Card swap
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Show the next card side by swapping the card body instead of reloading the page (same note type)

ListPreference.android:title: RWKV threads
ListPreference.android:summary: %s. Takes effect after kuma3 is closed from recent apps and opened again
